author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: "त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धे"त्यादिना प्राधान्येनोक्तेति भावः । वस्तुतस्तु श्रद्धाभावे शास्त्रानुसारित्वमेव नेति ज्ञेयम्
translation: Whatsoever is offered into the fire, given in charity, or practised as austerity, or performed, (though strictly in accordance with the rules of Sâstra), but without faith in the Lord), it is called Asat, O Partha; it is in vain in the world hereafter; and it is in vain even here. (28)
